The `UIRenderer` for holograms: a tree is stood in the world at a location for everyone to see, in place of whatever this renderer showed before, the way a screen replaces the one before it. A link goes to the chat of whoever clicked the hologram last.

Each tree goes up under the name it is shown with, unless the renderer was given an id of its own, in which case everything it shows goes up under that one id: the way to stand one ui that moves on to another when a button in it is pressed.

```java
import net.tutla.craftytml.paper.render.HologramRenderer;
```

## Members

### `public HologramRenderer(Location location)`

Stands each tree under the name it is shown with.

### `public HologramRenderer(Location location, String id)`

Stands everything under one id, each tree replacing the one before.
